rows_not_used.reason: Marked wrong_credit: fixed empirical-margin invariance does not refute the printed distribution-level information comparison.

omission_reason: The governing canonical statement is the printed information and reference-distribution comparison, with no accepted claim-text correction. The fixed-margin existential proposed in its historical note is not stated there, and the brief gives notes no instructional precedence. Its negation is immediate from the usable T2 margin-invariance theorem, but that fact does not refute the printed comparison: equality of full group margins is stronger than equality of the scalar KS, as the T2 scalar-KS witness explicitly shows. T1 pairing/design witnesses and T2 design identities establish their precise corrected claims without supplying a formal equivalence to the printed prose. The sole credited T5 row is also wrong_credit for this same semantic mismatch; it is not used. The helper refutation is therefore retained as content already implied by T2, rather than added as a new T5 theorem.

referee_resolution.a: Clarified the target-level omission rationale; declined the proposed note-based reinterpretation under brief.md:30-32 and work.json:569-575. The suggested fixed-margin negation is valid glue but is not a refutation of the governing printed statement.
referee_resolution.b: Accepted omission_ok after inspecting the source row and the canonical printed text. See REPORT.md, Round 1 referee findings and revision 2 actions.
